name: modal
title: Modal
description: Asks for a decision on top of the page. Focus stays inside until it closes.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The label of the button that opens it.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, read out when it opens.

props.name: description
props.demo: Its pages, settings and history will be removed. You can't undo this.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The label of the main action.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The label of the button that closes it.

props.name: tone
props.description: Danger colours the main action red, for things that can't be undone.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the main action is pressed, just before it closes.
